title: Corporate card and expense platform reconciliation to the ledger
prompt: Reconcile corporate card and expense-platform transactions to the ledger, including refunds, fees and settlements. Identify missing or duplicate postings.

setup.q: Which ledger accounts does each card or expense platform post to (card liability or clearing, fee expense, settlement bank account)?

steps: get the platform transactions for the month: the Ramp connection first, then the standing "Card platform export" csv, then a document request
pull the ledger rows for the mapped platform accounts for the period (card liability or clearing, fee expense, settlement bank account)
match platform transactions to ledger postings by platform id, then by date and amount; match refunds to their original charge, fees to the fee account and settlements to the bank outflow
run duplicate_pairs over the ledger postings with tolerance 0.01 (cents) and days 3 to find the same card transaction posted twice
list platform transactions with no posting (missing), postings with no platform transaction (unexplained) and duplicate postings, each with both ids
tie: platform statement total equals the ledger activity for the mapped accounts plus the listed differences

done.text: Every exception row cites the platform transaction id and, where one exists, the ledger transaction id
card-platform-reconciliation.xlsx opens with Exceptions first (count and total on the first rows), a Tie-out block whose Difference is 0.00, and no internal plumbing words
Refunds, fees and settlements are matched as their own item types, not folded into purchases; a missing posting is told apart from a duplicate posting and from a platform item still pending
The platform statement total and the ledger activity for the mapped accounts are both quoted on the Tie-out, with every difference listed and none netted
